lines.beaver_en: Hello. Could you explain the survey results?
lines.learner: 네. 먼저 국도 정체 사례부터 말씀드리겠습니다.
lines.en: Yes. I'll start with cases of national highway congestion.
lines.roman: ne. meonjeo gukdo jeongche saryebuteo malsseumdeurigetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Which section of the highway is the most jammed?
lines.learner: 정체의 대표적인 예로 3번 국도를 들 수 있습니다.
lines.en: National Highway 3 is a representative example of congestion.
lines.roman: jeongcheui daepyojeogin yero sambeon gukdoreul deul su itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Is the congestion bad on weekends too?
lines.learner: 네, 주말에는 나들이 차량이 많아서 더 심합니다.
lines.en: Yes, on weekends it's worse with many leisure trip cars.
lines.roman: ne, jumareneun nadeuri charyangi manaseo deo simhamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Are the rest stops crowded too?
lines.learner: 네, 휴게소에 들어가는 길까지 수시로 막힙니다.
lines.en: Yes, even the road into the rest stop jams up often.
lines.roman: ne, hyugesoe deureoganeun gilkkaji susiro makimnida.

lines.en: Subway platforms are crowded from the first train.

lines.learner: 항공기 이륙이 늦어서 기내에서 오래 기다립니다.
lines.en: Takeoffs are delayed, so people wait long on the plane.
lines.roman: hanggonggi iryugi neujeoseo ginaeeseo orae gidarimnida.

lines.learner: 네, 특히 일반석 승객들이 많이 힘들어합니다.
lines.en: Yes, economy class passengers especially have a hard time.
lines.roman: ne, teuki ilbanseok seunggaekdeuri mani himdeureohamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Did you also hear from the airlines?
lines.learner: 네, 항공사도 재작년부터 문제를 알고 있었습니다.
lines.en: Yes, the airlines have known about it since two years ago.
lines.roman: ne, hanggongsado jaejangnyeonbuteo munjereul algo isseotseumnida.

lines.learner: 해상 교통도 휴가철에는 항구가 아주 혼잡합니다.
lines.en: For sea travel, ports get very crowded in vacation season.
lines.roman: haesang gyotongdo hyugacheoreneun hangguga aju honjapamnida.

lines.beaver: 잘 들었습니다. 자료를 정리해서 보내 주십시오.
lines.beaver_en: Thank you. Please organize the data and send it.
lines.beaver_roman: jal deureotseumnida. jaryoreul jeongnihaeseo bonae jusipsio.
lines.learner: 네, 오늘 중으로 보내 드리겠습니다. 감사합니다.
lines.en: Sure, I'll send it today. Thank you.
lines.roman: ne, oneul jungeuro bonae deurigetseumnida. gamsahamnida.
